title: The biggest permanent desert lake threatens with rising waters and hungry crocs
summary: Kenya's Lake Turkana is the world's largest permanent desert lake. Its waters have long sustained hundreds of thousands. Now the lake is facing multiple threats — and threatening those who rely on it.
